description: Patch a branch, or disable it. 🔴 `trigger` and `match` MOVE TOGETHER, and so do `action` and `action_arg` — sending one without its partner is refused (422). A match names fields belonging to ONE trigger's grammar, so a half-pair would store a match its trigger cannot read: accepted, stored, and dead. Repeat the unchanged half. `enabled: false` keeps the rule and its reasoning visible while stopping it firing — prefer it over deleting when a human may want the rule back. Branch ids come from the campaign detail (`send_get_campaign` → `branches`).

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.
